name: Cabin Fever!!!
source:
Mel and Millie Derelict decide to get away from the chaos of Libretto City and medical school to go to a quaint, cozy cabin at Diamond Ridge...

Of course, what kind of story would this be if it all went according to plan? A mysterious being traps the two inside of the cabin: But all is not lost! If they can survive the winter (and each other) until the authorities arrive, everything will be TOTALLY fine!!!

(Just don't succumb to hunger and hatred!)

[From [url=https://liminace.itch.io/cabin-fever]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅尔和米莉决定远离利布雷托市和医学院的混乱，前往钻石岭的一间古色古香、舒适的小屋……

当然，如果一切都按计划进行的话，这会是一个怎样的故事呢？一个神秘生物将两人困在小屋内：但一切并没有失去！如果他们能够度过冬天（以及彼此）直到当局到来，一切都会好起来的！

（只是不要屈服于饥饿和仇恨！）

[来自[url=https://liminace.itch.io/cabin-fever]itch.io[/url]]
